mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which is associated with positive equity market returns over the next 20 trading days due to stronger corporate earnings visibility. The INDPRO index is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates and compresses valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous positive growth in GDP (GDPC1) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 0.5%), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 320 indicates elevated inflation and restrictive policy, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 320), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market with rising wage pressures, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved consumer spending and corporate pricing power.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.0%), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which is associated with positive equity market returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 320, it signals elevated inflation that triggers central bank policy responses, increasing equity risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 320), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it defines a monetary tightening regime that increases risk-free rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
